topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the lecture scope, framework, and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how genetic mutations driving clonal succession and non-mutational epigenetic alterations contribute to tumor evolution and fitness.

topics.label: Cancer stem cells and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: They explore tissue hierarchies and provide experimental evidence for the cancer stem cell model and defined cells of origin across different tumor types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how external stimuli, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma promote tumor development and offer therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It details the computational and experimental technologies used to track mutational timing and map spatial cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Integrated model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesises the interplay between mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions in driving cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It provides closing remarks and previews the topic of the upcoming lecture.
